title: Joint-Regent Commodity Data Storage

onscreen_lines.desc: Pricing Exercise #1 - Rackmount commodity storage server. Provide the total cost per the specifications detailed below. Component Specifications Qty Chassis 2U rackmount chassis with (8) 3.5"/2.5" hot-swap NVMe/SAS/SATA drive bays and (4) 3.5"/2.5" hot-swap NVMe/SATA drive bays. 1 Motherboard Dual socket 5th Gen Intel® Xeon® Scalable Processor, 32 DDR4-5600 DIMM slots, 6 PCI-E 5.0 x16. 1 Processor Intel® Xeon® Gold 6526Y (2.8GHz, 16 cores/32 threads, 37.5MB cache, DDR4-5200, 195W). 2 Heat Sink High-grade CPU heat sink. 2 Memory 32GB DDR5 5600MHz ECC RDIMM (512GB total). 16 Boot Drive 480GB Data center SSD (SATA 3.0 6Gb/s, 2.5", 1DWPD). Mirrored with linux mdadm for OS load. 2 NVMe Drive 3.2TB Data center NVMe SSD (PCIe Gen 4, 2.5", 3DWPD). 4 HBA Broadcom 9500-8e high-performance PCIe Gen 4 host bust adapter (12Gb/s). 4 Network Integrated dual-port 10GbE network adapter (RJ45). 1 System Management Integrated Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 port for out-of-band remote system management. 1 Network Intel® E810-XXVDA2 dual-port 25GbE network adapter card (SFP28). 1 Network 25GbE SFP+ transceivers. 2 OS Installed for burn-in and testing only. Customer will reinstall own image. 1 Power Supply Redundant 1600W 80+ platinum efficiency power supply. 2 Power Cord C13 to C14 power cable. 2 Rail Kit Rackmount rail kit included with chassis. 1

Pricing Exercise #2 - Data storage enclosure. Provide the total cost per the specifications detailed below. Component Specifications Qty Chassis 4U JBOD storage enclosure with (60) 3.5" hard drive bays, cable management arm for hot-swap drive maintenance, dual redundant hot-swap I/O modules with 6 miniSAS HD ports per I/O module, redundant hot-swap fan modules, and multi-zone configuration. 1 Data Drive Enterprise class 20TB HDD (3.5", SAS 12Gb/s, 7200RPM). 60 Data Drive Spare enterprise class 20TB HDD (3.5", SAS 12Gb/s, 7200RPM). 1 Cable External miniSAS HD to miniSAS HD cable (2m). 4 Power Supply Redundant 1600W 80+ platinum efficiency power supply. 2 Power Cord C13 to C14 power cable. 2 Configuration Validation and burn-in of storage components prior to shipping. 1 Rail Kit Rackmount rail kit included with chassis. 1
